items.zh: 客家話的「兒子」、「女兒」、「兒媳」和「女婿」的說法，都跟廣州話和普通話不同。
items.en: The Hakka terms for 'son', 'daughter', 'daughter-in-law', and 'son-in-law' are all different from Cantonese and Mandarin.

items.zh: {賴子: lai4 zu1}、{妹子: moi4 zu1}、{孫子: sun1 zu1}、{塞子: set5 zu1}的{{子}}唸**第一聲** `zú`。
items.en: The {{子}} in {賴子: lai4 zu1}, {妹子: moi4 zu1}, {孫子: sun1 zu1}, {塞子: set5 zu1} is pronounced with the **first tone** `zú`.

items.zh: {{正}}在客家話有三個發音： `záng` {正月: zang1 ngiet6}、`zàng` 「才/剛才」、`zìn` {正確: zin4 kok6}、{正能量: zin4 len2 liong4}。
items.en: {{正}} has three pronunciations in Hakka: `záng` 'First Month' - {正月: zang1 ngiet6}; `zàng` 'just/only then'; `zìn` 'correct/positive' - {正確: zin4 kok6}, {正能量: zin4 len2 liong4}.
